description: BidiIsolation.RTL_LOCALES with three catalogs whose LOCALES decide isolation: ar maximizes to ar-Arab-EG and isolates, en maximizes to en-Latn-US and does not, and x-private has no script subtag AND no likely subtag at all -- the only route to BidiUtils.localeUsesRightToLeftScript's `likelySubtag.isPresent()` FALSE arm, where `script` stays empty and isRightToLeftScript("") decides.
